name: Superior Prima Sukses Tbk.
summary: PT Superior Prima Sukses Tbk operates in Indonesia, specializing in the production and distribution of autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) products. This company is renowned for its lightweight construction bricks, which are marketed under the distinct brand names BLESSCON and SUPERIORE BLOCK. Established in 2013, its primary operations are based out of Surabaya, Indonesia.
